hints.title: Detecting Top-Left Farmland Corners
hints.text: Each farmland group is an isolated rectangle. The top-left cell of a group is any cell containing 1 where the cell above and the cell to the left are either out of bounds or 0.

hints.title: Expanding to the Bottom-Right Corner
hints.text: From top-left (r1, c1), expand downward while cells equal 1 to find r2, and expand rightward while cells equal 1 to find c2.

hints.title: Recording Boundaries
hints.text: Record the coordinate tuple [r1, c1, r2, c2] directly without needing recursive flood fill.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.space: O(1) auxiliary space beyond result list
complexity.notes: Every top-left corner is identified and expanded in linear total grid time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full DFS with visited tracking uses unnecessary call stack space for pure rectangles.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Top-left corner detection avoids maintaining a visited matrix.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that non-touching rectangles allow corner-based identification.
